consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 70 mph (113 km/h) steady, low 70s to ~80 F (about 22-26 C), wheel size not stated, battery-side (car display, not confirmed) | 2022 Lightning Lariat Extended Range, 131 kWh usable, dual-motor AWD (same pack and generation as our 2025 ER 131 kWh). 2.1 mi/kWh over 270 mi: 1000 / (2.1 x 1.609344) = 296 Wh/km (article: 29.5 kWh/100 km). Other tests seen: Out of Spec Platinum about 258-260 mi on roughly 130 kWh; Consumer Reports Lariat ER 270 mi. | Main session: the page calls 131 kWh usable; our data has 131 gross / 123 usable. Same pack.

supercharger_access.notes: Ford: adapter gives Tesla Supercharger access in the U.S. and Canada (programme from 29 Feb 2024; the cited Ford page names no model years, so eligibility of this model year is not shown by it; 2025 has the feature from the factory). Recorded: via adapter today.

charge_port.notes: Estimated: Ford requires an adapter for Superchargers on the Lightning (all years incl. 2025), so the truck has a CCS1 port; no NACS port change found 2022-2025.
